explanation: Normalize each active input x_l by l1 and use theta_l=alpha_l||x_l||1/||z||1. For AWGN, the norm2 triangle bound gives ||z/||z||1||2<=max_l||x_l/||x_l||1||2; for max-fractional use norm-infinity. BEC support is the union of active supports. For BSC, T_e(x)=max{a.x:0<=a_i<=1,sum a_i=e} is the interpolated top-e mass and is subadditive/positive-homogeneous. If e<e0=min_l w_BSC(x_l)/2, every T_e(x_l)<||x_l||1/2, hence T_e(z)<||z||1/2 and w_BSC(z)>=2e0. Every P point is a vertex convex combination, so the mixture inequality gives the minimum at a nonzero vertex. Cone rescaling and scale invariance identify K and P values. Fractional scales linearly and has unattained infimum0 on either nonzero continuous domain whenever K is nontrivial; finite nonzero vertices instead have a positive minimum.
scope: Accepted proof-step contribution to W, not the whole channel theorem. Minima are attained through nonzero P vertices in the nontrivial case; the degenerate P={0} case is explicitly +infinity.
